# Aqua Tech Polymers

> Indian manufacturer of press board, power transformer, kraft paper and
> crepe paper tube adhesives for transformer and electrical insulation
> manufacturers. Power transformer adhesive (ATP-3900B, ATP-120) supplies
> high-strength adhesives for power transformer insulation cylinders 8–10
> feet long, positioned as a cost-effective Indian alternative to imported
> German adhesives, supplied to leading Indian manufacturers under annual
> supply contracts.

## Products
- [Press Board Adhesive](https://aquatechpolymers.com/products/press-board-adhesive): Bonding adhesive for press board components used in transformer and electrical insulation manufacturing.
- [Power Transformer Adhesive](https://aquatechpolymers.com/products/power-transformer-adhesive): High-strength adhesive (ATP-3900B, ATP-120) for power transformer insulation cylinders, 8–10 feet long.
- [Kraft Paper Adhesive](https://aquatechpolymers.com/products/kraft-paper-adhesive): Adhesive for insulation kraft paper used in transformer and electrical insulation manufacturing.
- [Crepe Paper Tube Adhesive](https://aquatechpolymers.com/products/crepe-paper-tube-adhesive): Adhesive for crepe paper tube manufacturing in the transformer and electrical insulation industry.

## Power Transformer Adhesives
- [High-strength adhesives for power transformers](https://aquatechpolymers.com/power-transformer-adhesives): The full power transformer adhesive story — an Indian alternative to imported adhesives.

## Applications
- [Distribution Transformer](https://aquatechpolymers.com/applications/distribution-transformers)
- [Power Transformer](https://aquatechpolymers.com/applications/power-transformers)
- [Press Board Components](https://aquatechpolymers.com/applications/press-board-components)
- [Insulation Kit](https://aquatechpolymers.com/applications/insulation-kit)

Also supplied for: Pre-Compressed Board, Press Board, Laminated Board, Insulation
Kraft Paper, Dovetail Strips, Spacers, Electrical Insulation Components.
